articles.title: Scott Colom’s identical twin on his Senate edge: ‘We always kind of stood out’
articles.titleZh: 斯科特·科洛姆的同卵双胞胎兄弟在参议院选举中处于领先地位：“我们一直都比较出众”
articles.summary:
Senator-elect Scott Colom owes part of his political edge to growing up as an identical twin, according to his twin brother Andrew. Among Senate Democrats, the Mississippi senator will be the fourth with an identical twin. 

Andrew Colom tells CNN’s Erin Burnett: "It kinda helps Scott know how to stand out because he was used to getting a lot of attention for being a twin."

articles.title: Colom will be Mississippi’s first Black senator since Reconstruction
articles.titleZh: 科洛姆将成为重建时期以来密西西比州的首位黑人参议员
articles.summary:
Democrat Scott Colom scored a major upset in Mississippi, narrowly defeating Republican incumbent Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith. The victory makes Colom the first Democratic senator elected from Mississippi in 44 years and the first Black person elected statewide since Reconstruction. Scott’s identical twin brother, Andrew Colom, joins CNN for an exclusive interview, reacting to the emotional moment the race was called and explaining what his brother’s historic victory means for Mississippi and the country.

Also, the panel analyzes how Colom managed to flip a deep-red seat, from his focus on kitchen-table concerns like grocery and diesel costs to his outreach to Black and rural voters. They also examine what the victory could mean for Democratic strategy across the South and the balance of power in the Senate.

2:29 Andrew Colom reacts to twin brother’s victory
5:10 Civil rights legacy and the road to victory for Colom
7:33 Viral campaign ad and why it worked so well
8:41 The shifting role of faith and values in politics

articles.readingText:
Democrat Scott Colom scored a major upset in Mississippi, narrowly defeating Republican incumbent Sen.

Cindy Hyde-Smith.

The victory makes Colom the first Democratic senator elected from Mississippi in 44 years and the first Black person elected statewide since Reconstruction.

Scott’s identical twin brother, Andrew Colom, joins CNN for an exclusive interview, reacting to the emotional moment the race was called and explaining what his brother’s historic victory means for Mississippi and the country.

Also, the panel analyzes how Colom managed to flip a deep-red seat, from his focus on kitchen-table concerns like grocery and diesel costs to his outreach to Black and rural voters.

They also examine what the victory could mean for Democratic strategy across the South and the balance of power in the Senate.
articles.readingTextZh:
民主党人斯科特·科洛姆在密西西比州大爆冷门，险胜共和党现任参议员

辛迪·海德-史密斯。

这场胜利使科洛姆成为44年来密西西比州首位当选的民主党参议员，也是自重建时期以来该州首位当选的黑人参议员。

斯科特的同卵双胞胎兄弟安德鲁·科洛姆（Andrew Colom）接受了CNN的独家采访，对选举结果揭晓时的激动时刻发表了看法，并解释了其兄弟的历史性胜利对密西西比州和整个国家意味着什么。

此外，该小组还分析了科洛姆是如何成功地将一个深红色席位转变为蓝色席位的，从他专注于食品杂货和柴油成本等餐桌话题，到他向黑人选民和农村选民进行宣传。

他们还分析了这场胜利可能对民主党在整个南方地区的战略以及参议院的权力平衡有何影响。
